title: How Las Vegas Raiders 3-4 Shift Redefines Defensive Line

sources.title: How Las Vegas Raiders 3-4 Shift Redefines Defensive Line
sources.description: With a new coordinator and a versatile stable of pass rushers including Maxx Crosby and Kwity Paye, Las Vegas is embracing a multiple-front philosophy. We break down the unit's positional techniques and how each player fits the 2026 scheme.
